name: Adolion Narrator
text:
You came to Aegis City to make a name with a blade, a bow or a spell, and three days ago you signed the Adventurers' Guild register to do it. Your Guild badge is new, your purse is light, and you have no party yet. The Guild sends no one out alone.

Today the hall is loud enough to be heard from the street. At the counter, Tobias, who hands out the Guild's work, has set a register beside the quest board and keeps tapping one notice: Wendhope, a mining village in the north that has gone silent, offering more coin than a collapsed mine should be worth.

Two others are looking for a party too. Belle, a barbarian out of the Mountains of Shadow with a greataxe as tall as she is, leans in the tavern arch and makes no secret of being bored. Dalan, a quiet elf archer who has drifted between parties for a year, pretends to read the notices. Beside Tobias, Ellie keeps glancing from those two to you, pen already inked to write a new party's name into the Guild's book.

name: Max Nightriver
text: We take Wendhope as the Red Hands.

name: Ellie
text: Ellie's pen hovers over the register, ready and waiting. "The Red Hands, then." She writes the name in elegant script, her blue eyes flickering briefly toward Belle and Dalan with a knowing sort of excitement. A small flush touches her cheeks as she taps the ink dry. "I'll have you sign here, please. Rank D. Investigate Wendhope, in Sheridan lands."

name: Max Nightriver
text: We ride north.

name: Adolion Narrator
text:
The forest road narrows as the party rides north, the sound of hoofbeats and wagon wheels swallowed by pine needles. By mid-afternoon the trees press close, their branches woven together like a cathedral ceiling of green and shadow. The air turns cool and smells of damp earth and rotting leaves.
Dalan reins his horse in, his hand drifting to his bow. "There," he says quietly, pointing to a splash of red among the grey trunks ahead. A rider in Sheridan colors sprawls across the road, face down in the dirt, an arrow in his back.

name: Max Nightriver
text: I dismount and check the rider. Is he still breathing? Dalan, watch the trees.

name: Dalan
text: Dalan's horse wheels around with a fluid, practiced movement, and his shortbow is out before he has even fully turned. "On it," he murmurs, voice dropping to a calm, sharp whisper. He scans the treeline with pale, keen eyes, one hand on his reins. "Something felt wrong about this road. Rider's colors mean help should have been close, but it's too quiet."

name: Max Nightriver
text: Belle, help me turn him over. What does the Sheridan badge say?

name: Belle
text:
Belle's boots crunch through the pine needles as she strides forward, the massive greataxe resting casually against her shoulder. She drops onto one knee beside the rider, her muscled arms working with practiced ease to roll the man onto his back.
"Doesn't look like he's breathing, but I've seen 'dead' men kick back before," she mutters, leaning close to check for the rise and fall of his chest. Her brown eyes scan the rider's face, then flick down to the silver and blue badge pinned to his breast. " Sheridan messenger, by the look of it. Probably carried whatever word got sent to Aegis City." She narrows her eyes, her hand drifting toward the arrow protruding from the man's back. "You want me to pull the arrow or just look at the damn badge?"

name: Adolion Narrator
text: The rider's eyes have rolled back, only the whites visible. A dark bruise is already blooming around his temple. Belle's strong fingers pry at the badge, her nails leaving scrapes in the metal, and she holds it up to the light filtering through the pines.

name: Max Nightriver
text: We bury him by the road and keep the badge for Wendhope's headman.

name: Adolion Narrator
text:
Belle's expression darkens, then settles into a grim nod. "Right. Wouldn't want some scavengers stripping him bare." She heaves the rider's body onto her shoulder with a grunt of effort, her greataxe already biting into the soft forest soil as she digs a shallow trench by the road's edge. Dirt flies in clumps as she works with the steady, brutal efficiency of someone who has buried her share of the dead.
Dalan keeps his bow drawn, his gaze sweeping the treeline with sharp, pale eyes. "Hurry," he says softly, voice tight with tension. "This much noise in a quiet forest draws attention."
Once the body is lowered and covered with a layer of pine needles and earth, Belle steps back to pat the grave flat. She slips the Sheridan badge into a pouch at her belt, her fingers lingering on the metal for a moment. "There. Now we find this headman." She mounts her horse with a heavy thud of leather and iron. "Let's move before we're the ones being buried."

name: Max Nightriver
text: Mount up, Red Hands. We've a job in Wendhope and it won't wait.

name: Belle
text: Belle's already in the saddle, her greataxe strapped across her back. She kicks her horse into a trot, glancing over at Max with a sharp grin. "Finally. Been staring at these goddamn trees long enough to count every goddamn needle." She digs her heels in, her black hair whipping back as her mount picks up speed. "Wendhope, right. Let's see what's got them so scared."

name: Dalan
text:
Dalan is already in the stirrups, his bow slung over his shoulder and his hands gripping the reins tight. He casts one more wary glance at the treeline, pointed ears twitching as if listening for a sound that might not be there. "Something's not right about this," he says, his soft voice barely carrying over the wind in the pines. "We should ride hard until we hit the walls."
He turns his horse's head toward the north and gives the beast a sharp nudge, his slender frame moving in tandem with the horse's gait as they break into a gallop. "Stay close," he adds, his pale eyes already scanning the horizon. "If we're being tracked, we'll know soon enough."

name: Max Nightriver
text: We keep riding north. Anyone else notice there's no traffic on this road?

name: Dalan
text: "Too notice," he murmurs, his eyes never leaving the treeline as they ride. "This is a trade road to the mines. There should be ore carts, merchant wagons... something." His voice carries a quiet edge of concern. "Not even a stray dog."

name: Belle
text: Belle lets out a sharp laugh that rings hollow in the quiet woods. "You're goddamn right, Nightriver. Not a single soul. No traders, no guards, not even a stray shit-hound to bark at us." She adjusts the weight of Cleaver on her back, her brown eyes scanning the road ahead. "Something's rotten as a three-day-old corpse. And we're riding straight into it."

name: Max Nightriver
text: We make camp off the road at dusk. Dalan, first watch. Belle, who did you run with before the Red Hands?

name: Belle
text:
Belle grunts as she pulls her horse to a halt, eyeing the darkening treeline. "Off the road? Good thinking. Stupid to sleep where we're easy to spot." She dismounts in one smooth motion and begins to clear a small patch of ground, her movements efficient and sure.
She pauses, looking up at Max with an unreadable expression. "Before this? Nobody. I've been hunting for coin by myself since I got to this city." Her jaw tightens. "Turns out most folks don't like taking a woman with an axe that big on their runs. Prefer some pretty little thing with a staff or a bow." She kicks at the dirt, her voice dropping a notch. "But a couple of drunkards tried to rope me into a party once. Lasted three days before the lead fool got his throat slit by a goblin. I buried him and kept riding."

name: Dalan
text:
Dalan's horse whinnies softly as he pulls it to a stop, and he's already unbuckling the saddle before the question finishes. "I've been with a few," he says, his voice soft and matter-of-fact as he starts leading his mount to the picket line. "Most didn't last past the first quest. Too much shouting, not enough planning."
He turns to face Max and Belle, his pale eyes catching the last of the light. "Some tried to make me their scout because I'm quiet. Others... well, they called me cute and it didn't go well." A slight flush touches his cheeks as he looks away. "But I'll keep us safe tonight. You should rest."

name: Max Nightriver
text: I take second watch. Wake me if anything moves.

name: Dalan
text: Dalan nods once, sharp and clear, and slips into the shadows at the edge of camp. His slender frame becomes almost invisible against the dark trunks, his bow resting across his lap. "I will," he says softly, his pale eyes already sweeping the treeline.

name: Belle
text: Belle settles into the bedroll with a satisfied grunt, her greataxe propped within arm's reach. She rolls onto her back, staring up at the emerging stars visible through the canopy. "Good. Don't want you getting all rusty." She closes her eyes, but her hand remains close to the weapon's handle.

name: Max Nightriver
text: At first light we ride on toward Wendhope.

name: Dalan
text: Dalan emerges from the treeline at first light, his eyes tired but alert. "Nothing moved all night," he says softly as he begins to lead his horse back to the center of camp. "Too quiet. Even the birds aren't singing this morning." He mounts his horse with practiced ease, his bow already slung over his shoulder. "We should move carefully."

name: Adolion Narrator
text:
The forest holds its breath as the party rides on, the only sounds the rhythmic thud of hoofbeats on the packed earth and the creak of leather. Pine branches claw at their cloaks as the road narrows further, twisting through ravines that funnel the damp morning chill. By midday the treeline finally breaks, and the village of Wendhope rises in the distance: a palisade of rough-hewn timber with a gate barred tight and torches burning in the daylight along the walls.
Belle reins her horse in, squinting at the barricade. "Well. They're definitely not expecting company," she says, her hand resting on the hilt of Cleaver. "Wonder who's on the other side of that wall."
